h_regions.name: genetic-cause
h_regions.description: Papers that establish SIT1 as the causal gene for IMD135 through patient genetics, segregation, or pathogenic variant interpretation.

h_regions.name: patient-report
h_regions.description: Papers that describe one or more affected patients or families with the IMD135 phenotype, including original cases and later case reports/cohorts.

h_regions.name: functional-mechanism
h_regions.description: Papers that experimentally test SIT1 variants or SIT1 pathway defects to explain the immunodeficiency mechanism.

h_regions.name: literature-minimum
h_regions.description: The IMD135 literature is effectively a single-paper disease report that simultaneously establishes the gene–phenotype link and the mechanism, with no distinct later case series or separate functional follow-up.

h_regions.name: alternate-label-patient
h_regions.description: Additional patient reports may exist but are indexed only under broader or older clinical labels (e.g., combined immunodeficiency, severe combined immunodeficiency, dysregulated T-cell receptor signaling) rather than the IMD135 label.

h_regions.name: background-biology-only
h_regions.description: The SIT1 literature relevant to IMD135 may consist mainly of pre-disease mechanistic SIT1 biology papers that provide context but do not add any patient evidence or disease-specific variant interpretation.

h_regions.name: publication-absence
h_regions.description: Claims about whether the IMD135 literature does or does not include distinct additional papers beyond the known case report, including the possibility that PubMed evidence is exhausted by one report and background biology.

h_regions.name: review-or-background
h_regions.description: Papers that mention SIT1 and immunodeficiency only as background, review, or unrelated mechanistic context rather than reporting patients or variant-specific disease evidence.

o_regions.name: rare-disease case reports
o_regions.description: Individual patient/family reports, brief communications, and case series indexed in PubMed.

o_regions.name: genetic-discovery papers
o_regions.description: Studies with sequencing, segregation, locus discovery, or variant interpretation linking SIT1 to disease.

o_regions.name: functional studies
o_regions.description: Cellular, biochemical, structural, or model-organism experiments on SIT1 variants or signaling defects relevant to disease.
